name: Jagannath_Charity_Foundation
description: Professional React/Vite website for Jagannath Foundation, a public charitable trust advancing education, healthcare, youth skills, livelihoods, environment, and clean energy across India.

paragraphs: Public website and private administration console for Jagannath Charity Foundation. The application uses React, TypeScript and Vite for the frontend, FastAPI for the API, and SQLAlchemy with MySQL or SQLite for persistence.
features: Public pages for the Foundation's programmes, team, gallery, contact, volunteering and pledge notes.
Database-backed admin login with bcrypt password hashes; credentials are never configured in source code or hosting environment variables.
Admin tools for editing selected site copy, replacing managed images and handling form submissions.
Vercel frontend and Railway API deployment support.
